facts.statement: Fossil evidence confirms Majungasaurus fed on the sauropod Rapetosaurus, leaving distinct tooth marks on its bones.

facts.statement: Majungasaurus possessed pneumatic foramina in its vertebrae and ribs, suggesting it had an avian-style respiratory system with air sacs.

facts.statement: The brain of Majungasaurus was very small relative to its body size and had a conservative structure closer to modern crocodilians than to birds.
